message: test(merchant): reuse isolated catalog layout for fresh boundary realms
purpose: The unfiltered native log contains passing assertions and shows repeated full-world hunting-plan construction consuming the unchanged 120-second control budget. Reuse the already isolated merchant fixture catalog so its immutable hunting layout cache survives into the boundary fixture. Still construct fresh RealmEngine state with the complete population. Do not remove any region, creature, assertion or test. Add isolation and population-equality checks and restore the temporary ore price and stack limit. Production code, test ordering, timeouts and all expected sale results remain unchanged.

replacements.old: public static async Task Run(Node host, GameRoot game, Action<bool, string> check)
replacements.new: public static async Task Run(Node host, GameRoot game, Action<bool, string> check, Catalog fixtureData, int expectedPopulation)
